ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated ratio of 1:15 white to black pixels on visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark mass across both lobes; high-intensity white focal clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered across the inferior-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 65-75 degrees at the convergence of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel peaks on the central-right lobe, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular protrusions on distal tips caused by bio-fouling.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to convex on the outer lateral margins; right lobe shows a more linear taper than the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular white high-contrast pixel groups (approx. 5-20 pixels in diameter) concentrated heavily on the fluke tips and lower-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks (scratches) visible on the dark surface of the left lobe, oriented vertically and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on both fluke tips, creating significant three-dimensional textural irregularities and high-contrast white boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense 'star-field' pattern of small white specks concentrated on the lower-left portion of the visible fluke surface.
